sentences.zh: 我能从浴室镜子里看到自己，看着我的胸部，当时那部位真的开始发育了。

sentences.en: And I was like, wow, I don't like this.
sentences.zh: 我就想，哇，我不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I don't want this on my body.
sentences.zh: 我不想要它长在我的身体上。

sentences.en: I knew that having breasts or having wide hips would make people look at me like I was a girl and I wanted them to view me as masculine and like the tomboy that I used to be
sentences.zh: 我知道长出乳房或胯部变宽会让人们把我当成女孩看，而我希望他们把我视为男性，就像我过去被视为假小子那样。

sentences.en: perceived as.
sentences.zh: 被看待。

sentences.en: And it's around this time that a friend came out to Grayson as non-binary, meaning they didn't identify as being a boy or a girl.
sentences.zh: 大约就在这个时候，格雷森的一位朋友向他出柜，说自己是非二元性别者，意味着他们不认为自己是男孩或女孩。

sentences.en: And Grayson started thinking about his own gender identity.
sentences.zh: 格雷森开始思考自己的性别认同。

sentences.en: He googled terms like genderqueer and transgender and he really connected with what he was reading.
sentences.zh: 他搜索了诸如“酷儿性别”和“跨性别”之类的词，并与他所读到的内容产生了强烈的共鸣。

sentences.en: He felt like it sort of described what he was feeling at the time, but he wasn't ready to accept it.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这些词在某种程度上描述了他当时的感受，但他还没准备好接受它。

sentences.en: And the people I surrounded myself with really did not help because they knew like other trans kids at our school and they always were like, oh, they're looking for attention.
sentences.zh: 我身边的人真的帮不上忙，因为他们认识学校里的其他跨性别孩子，他们总是说，哦，他们只是在博取关注。

sentences.en: And basically, I don't know why, but I listened to them and I was like, yeah, maybe I'm just looking for attention and I'd be looking for attention if I told anyone.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我不知道为什么，但我听信了他们，心想，也许我真的只是在博取关注，如果我告诉任何人，我就是在博取关注。

sentences.en: So for a really long time, I kept it to myself.
sentences.zh: 所以很长一段时间里，我把它藏在心里。

sentences.en: I remember vividly that like every single night
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得，每天晚上

sentences.en: I'd come home so sad.
sentences.zh: 我回到家都很难过。

sentences.en: I didn't know why and then I'd just start to cry when I got to my room.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么，回到房间就会开始哭。

sentences.en: And I would do that.
sentences.zh: 我总是那样。

sentences.en: I would cry for a while and then I would get up and I would do homework and then I'd cry again and then I'd go eat dinner and act like everything was normal.
sentences.zh: 我会哭上一会儿，然后起来写作业，接着又哭，然后去吃晚饭，装作一切正常。

sentences.en: And when I was around my family, I would be like, yes, I'm who you think I am.
sentences.zh: 当我和家人在一起时，我会表现得，是的，我就是你们认为的那个人。

sentences.en: And then I would go back in my room and I'd cry because I was lying to everyone in my life.
sentences.zh: 然后我会回到房间哭，因为我在对自己生活中的每个人撒谎。

sentences.en: And so that's how they get to that moment at the dinner table when Grayson tells Holly what's going on.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们如何走到餐桌前那一刻的，当时格雷森告诉了霍莉发生了什么。

sentences.en: How did you feel hearing that?
sentences.zh: 听到这些时你是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Surprise
sentences.zh: 惊讶

sentences.en: and relief.
sentences.zh: 和宽慰。

sentences.en: I was surprised because my own bias as a lesbian,
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶，因为作为一名女同性恋者，我有自己的偏见，

sentences.en: I thought that my daughter was probably a butch lesbian and that's why she was such a tomboy.
sentences.zh: 我以为我的女儿可能是一个阳刚型的女同性恋，所以她才那么像个假小子。

sentences.en: so I was surprised to hear it was a gender identity thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我很惊讶听到这竟然是性别认同的问题。

sentences.en: But I was also relieved because
sentences.zh: 但我也感到宽慰，因为

sentences.en: a lot made sense then.
sentences.zh: 很多事情在那时都说得通了。

sentences.en: Holly says this took her back to her own experience coming out to her parents decades earlier.
sentences.zh: 霍莉说，这让她回想起了几十年前她自己向父母出柜的经历。

sentences.en: And on the one hand,
sentences.zh: 一方面，

sentences.en: I'm sure it's how my parents felt when I told them I was gay.
sentences.zh: 我相信这和我告诉父母我是同性恋时他们的感受是一样的。

sentences.en: It's probably exactly the same feeling.
sentences.zh: 可能感觉完全一样。

sentences.en: It gave her some understanding of what her parents had struggled with.
sentences.zh: 这让她对父母曾经的挣扎有了一些理解。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it made her want to react differently to Grayson than they had reacted to her.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，这让她想要以不同于父母对待她的方式来对待格雷森。

sentences.en: I think maybe because, maybe because I'd had the experience myself of not living as who I was and having to hide,
sentences.zh: 我想也许是因为，也许是因为我自己有过那种无法以真实自我生活、不得不隐藏的经历，

sentences.en: I didn't want that for my son because I knew how difficult it was.
sentences.zh: 我不希望我的儿子也经历这些，因为我知道那有多困难。

sentences.en: Maybe, maybe that's part of it.
sentences.zh: 也许，也许这就是部分原因。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I know that that feeling is just so awful and you feel like you're lying to people and it's just very difficult.
sentences.zh: 但我知道那种感觉太糟糕了，你会觉得自己是在欺骗别人，这真的非常困难。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: maybe because I had the experience, I was more, you know, I did want a different experience for my child than I had for myself.
sentences.zh: 也许因为我有过那种经历，我更，你知道，我确实希望我的孩子能有与我不同的经历。

sentences.en: And so,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Grayson remembers her telling him that moment at the dinner table.
sentences.zh: 格雷森记得她在餐桌前对他说了那番话。

sentences.en: Yes, it's perfectly fine.
sentences.zh: 是的，这完全没问题。

sentences.en: And I love you regardless.
sentences.zh: 无论如何我都爱你。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Holly goes to Grayson's pediatrician with this information and the pediatrician tells her about a clinic in Dallas called Genesis that might be able to support Grayson.
sentences.zh: 霍莉带着这些信息去了格雷森的儿科医生那里，医生告诉她达拉斯有一家叫“创世纪”的诊所，也许能为格雷森提供支持。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm interested to hear that a clinic like this existed in Dallas, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶在德克萨斯州达拉斯竟然有这样的诊所。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有趣。

sentences.en: So, when Genesis opened back in 2014, it was the only youth gender clinic in the entire SouthweSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，当“创世纪”在2014年开业时，它是整个美国西南部唯一的青少年性别诊所。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: And it was opened after this pediatric endocrinologist,
sentences.zh: 它是在儿科内分泌学家

sentences.en: Jimena Lopez, saw her first trans patient.
sentences.zh: 吉梅娜·洛佩兹见到她的第一位跨性别患者后开设的。

sentences.en: And this kid was really struggling with starting to go through puberty.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子在进入青春期时非常挣扎。

sentences.en: They were really depressed.
sentences.zh: 他们非常抑郁。

sentences.en: And so, she went, you know, across the country and asked different specialists, you know, how can I best support this kid?
sentences.zh: 所以，她去了全国各地，询问不同的专家，你知道，我该如何最好地支持这个孩子？

sentences.en: And this was around the time that medical consensus was really starting to crystallize around the value of this sort of care for trans kids.
sentences.zh: 当时医学界对于这种针对跨性别儿童的护理价值已经开始形成共识。

sentences.en: And so,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Dr. Lopez brought that back home.
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹医生把这些带回了家。

sentences.en: And once she started providing that treatment to the kid, she was really shocked at how quickly the kid turned around emotionally.
sentences.zh: 一旦她开始为那个孩子提供治疗，她真的很震惊，那个孩子在情感上的好转速度如此之快。

sentences.en: And, you know, word got around that she was providing this type of care and soon she was seeing five patients, ten patients, fifty patients.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她提供这种护理的消息传开了，很快她就开始看五名、十名、五十名患者。

sentences.en: And so, at some point,
sentences.zh: 所以，在某个时候，

sentences.en: Dr. Lopez approaches the Children's Hospital at the University of Texas
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹医生联系了德克萨斯大学

sentences.en: Southwestern Medical Center.
sentences.zh: 西南医学中心的儿童医院，

sentences.en: which is a public institution and makes the case for the creation of this new center to be based there.
sentences.zh: 那是一家公立机构，并提出了在那里建立这个新中心的理由。

sentences.en: And the university was essentially like, sure, they weren't going to broadcast the work that they were doing necessarily, but they were okay with her moving forward
sentences.zh: 大学基本上表示同意，他们不一定会大肆宣传他们正在做的工作，但他们同意她推进

sentences.en: with what she had proposed.
sentences.zh: 她所提议的项目。

sentences.en: And over the next few years, the clinic starts to build up dozens and then hundreds of patients in Texas.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，该诊所在德克萨斯州积累了数十名，然后是数百名患者。

sentences.en: And it becomes a place that's known for really being supportive of kids who want to transition and for being one of the early places to publish research about how their patients
sentences.zh: 它成为了一个以支持想要转性的孩子而闻名的地方，也是最早发表关于患者随时间推移

sentences.en: are doing as time goes on.
sentences.zh: 状况的研究机构之一。

sentences.en: And so, when Grayson's pediatrician hears from Holly, it's really the obvious place to recommend that they go.
sentences.zh: 所以，当格雷森的儿科医生从霍莉那里听到消息时，这显然是推荐他们去的地方。

sentences.en: How did you feel the moment you heard about
sentences.zh: 当你听到关于

sentences.en: Genesis?
sentences.zh: “创世纪”的消息时，你是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I had up to that point not known that it had existed.
sentences.zh: 在那之前我根本不知道它的存在。

sentences.en: So it was like a light bulb went off.
sentences.zh: 所以就像灯泡突然亮了一样。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, this is, this is my chance.
sentences.zh: 我想，哦，这是，这是我的机会。

sentences.en: And for Grayson and Holly, it's feeling like the beginning of an answer.
sentences.zh: 对于格雷森和霍莉来说，这感觉像是找到了答案的开端。

sentences.en: Okay, so,
sentences.zh: 好的，那么，

sentences.en: Azeen, what happens once Holly and Grayson find out about Genesis?
sentences.zh: 阿辛，霍莉和格雷森发现“创世纪”之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, in 2019, after they'd been waiting something like two months for an appointment,
sentences.zh: 2019年，在等待了大约两个月预约后，

sentences.en: Grayson and Holly are finally on their way to their first appointment at Genesis.
sentences.zh: 格雷森和霍莉终于在前往“创世纪”进行第一次预约的路上。

sentences.en: And, you know, as they're walking through the front doors,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当他们走进前门时，

sentences.en: Grayson is really excited.
sentences.zh: 格雷森非常兴奋。

sentences.en: It was like, almost like nervous excitement.
sentences.zh: 那几乎是一种紧张的兴奋。

sentences.en: Felt sterile to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那里很冷清。

sentences.en: Holly is more nervous.
sentences.zh: 霍莉更紧张。

sentences.en: So it was a little unsettling at first to walk into the clinic not knowing what lay ahead,
sentences.zh: 所以刚走进诊所时有点不安，不知道前面会发生什么，

sentences.en: what this appointment was going to be like, who would we be talking to, what would the questions be, what would the outcome be, I would say...
sentences.zh: 这次预约会是什么样，我们会和谁交谈，会有什么问题，结果会如何，我想说……

sentences.en: And what happens at this first visit?
sentences.zh: 第一次访问发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, that first day at the clinic, they met with a psychologist for like three to four hours.
sentences.zh: 在诊所的第一天，他们和一位心理学家谈了大约三到四个小时。

sentences.en: Grayson sat down with them first and then Holly.
sentences.zh: 格雷森先和他们坐下来谈，然后是霍莉。

sentences.en: And the main goal is to figure out how Grayson is experiencing his gender identity and how much he understands about what the options are to help him at this point.
sentences.zh: 主要目标是弄清楚格雷森是如何体验自己的性别认同的，以及他对自己目前有哪些帮助选择了解多少。

sentences.en: So, the psychologist is asking him questions like, when did he start questioning his gender identity?
sentences.zh: 所以，心理学家问他一些问题，比如，他是什么时候开始质疑自己的性别认同的？

sentences.en: What was childhood like?
sentences.zh: 童年是什么样的？

sentences.en: What's his experience been of his gender up to this point?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他对自己的性别有什么体验？

sentences.en: Does he have distress about his body and how could he feel better about that?
sentences.zh: 他是否对自己的身体感到痛苦，怎样才能让他感觉好些？

sentences.en: Has he struggled with his mental health?
sentences.zh: 他在心理健康方面是否有过挣扎？

sentences.en: How is stuff going with school, with family, with friends?
sentences.zh: 在学校、家庭和朋友方面情况如何？

sentences.en: And also questions like, has he thought about going on hormones?
sentences.zh: 还有一些问题，比如，他是否考虑过进行激素治疗？

sentences.en: Does he understand what changes that would cause?
sentences.zh: 他是否了解这会引起什么变化？

sentences.en: And does he understand that there is some chance, though it's thought to be pretty small, that he might change his mind down the line?
sentences.zh: 他是否明白虽然可能性很小，但未来他仍有改变主意的可能？

sentences.en: And by the end of that first day, the psychologist got together with Holly and Grayson and told them that Grayson was exhibiting signs of what the psychologist called moderate
sentences.zh: 第一天结束时，心理学家与霍莉和格雷森坐在一起，告诉他们格雷森表现出了心理学家所说的中度

sentences.en: to severe gender dysphoria.
sentences.zh: 到重度性别焦虑的迹象。

sentences.en: And that was causing him a lot of distress.
sentences.zh: 这让他感到非常痛苦。

sentences.en: Do you remember like what that felt like to hear a label sort of put on?
sentences.zh: 你还记得听到这种标签被贴在

sentences.en: What he was going through?
sentences.zh: 你所经历的事情上是什么感觉吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I remember.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: I'm going to try to describe it.
sentences.zh: 我试着描述一下。

sentences.en: It's a mixed bag.
sentences.zh: 那是一种复杂的感觉。

sentences.en: It was a little bit relieving, but it was also startling
sentences.zh: 有一点宽慰，但同时也令人吃惊，

sentences.en: in a sense because I'm not sure that we expected it, although we knew it was a possibility.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，因为我不确定我们是否预料到了这一点，尽管我们知道这是一种可能性。

sentences.en: Hearing it out loud from a professional is a little different.
sentences.zh: 从专业人士口中听到它，感觉还是有点不同。

sentences.en: And it was a little scary at the same time as it was relieving.
sentences.zh: 在感到宽慰的同时，也有一点害怕。

sentences.en: But it was definitely relieving too.
sentences.zh: 但这也绝对是一种解脱。

sentences.en: I know I use that word a lot, but I think the fact that I use it a lot speaks to the amount of distress we were all feeling prior to this.
sentences.zh: 我知道我经常用这个词，但我认为我频繁使用它，恰恰说明了在此之前我们所有人都承受着多么大的痛苦。

sentences.en: Literally the same day, she sent us up to another floor where I met with the doctor and talked about potential paths that I could take for transitioning.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，她把我们转到了另一个楼层，我在那里见了医生，讨论了我可以采取的性别过渡的潜在途径。

sentences.en: So after this assessment, the next step is to talk about what sort of options are available to Grayson.
sentences.zh: 所以评估之后，下一步就是讨论格雷森（Grayson）有哪些选择。

sentences.en: And the clinic tells me that this depends on a range of factors, including how ready the family is to begin care and what kind of treatment they're looking for.
sentences.zh: 诊所告诉我，这取决于多种因素，包括家庭开始护理的准备程度，以及他们寻求什么样的治疗。

sentences.en: You could try, you know, puberty blockers.
sentences.zh: 你可以尝试，你知道，青春期阻断剂。

sentences.en: You could try hormones.
sentences.zh: 你可以尝试激素治疗。

sentences.en: You could do nothing.
sentences.zh: 你也可以什么都不做。

sentences.en: And, you know, hope as mental health improves, you could do counseling.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，希望随着心理健康的改善，你可以进行心理咨询。

sentences.en: We'd already gone the counseling route
sentences.zh: 我们已经走过心理咨询这条路了，

sentences.en: and counseling hadn't really helped at that point
sentences.zh: 但当时心理咨询并没有真正起到帮助，

sentences.en: and medication that had been prescribed by psychiatrists hadn't helped with the depression.
sentences.zh: 而且精神科医生开的药物对抑郁症也没有帮助。

sentences.en: That history left Holly feeling open to the possibility of a medical transition, which is what Grayson felt he wanted.
sentences.zh: 那段经历让霍莉（Holly）对医疗过渡的可能性持开放态度，而这正是格雷森觉得他想要的。

sentences.en: But another factor that has to be considered is what stage of puberty a young person is at when they start this process.
sentences.zh: 但另一个必须考虑的因素是，年轻人在开始这个过程时处于青春期的哪个阶段。

sentences.en: In Grayson's case, he had already gone through female puberty, so it was too late to take puberty blockers.
sentences.zh: 就格雷森的情况而言，他已经经历了女性青春期，所以现在服用青春期阻断剂已经太晚了。
